subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw solve pre-processing text acknowledgements as a global messages config, as channel-owned placeholder behavior, or as a non-terminal plugin/channel hook contract?
rationale: The gap is real, but adding config/default surface or a plugin API affects compatibility and overlaps existing reactions, typing, status reactions, and channel-specific placeholder work.

options.title: Design a generic send-and-continue contract
options.body: Add a default-off API/config seam that can send interim acknowledgement text without terminating normal model dispatch, then migrate channel implementations through that one path.

options.title: Keep it channel-specific first
options.body: Let Slack, Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, and Feishu solve placeholders independently, accepting UX divergence while avoiding a premature core contract.

options.title: Decline new core/API surface
options.body: Keep ack reactions and typing indicators as the supported acknowledgement mechanisms and route richer behavior to plugin-specific implementations only.

recommendation.title: Design a generic send-and-continue contract
recommendation.body: Add a default-off API/config seam that can send interim acknowledgement text without terminating normal model dispatch, then migrate channel implementations through that one path.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest current-history and prior-review routing candidate for the shared dispatch/config boundary.
